# Jakub Stawowy

> Python / Backend Software Engineer based in Poznań, Poland. Available for remote work.

Jakub Stawowy is a software engineer with commercial experience spanning from junior to senior level. His primary expertise is Python and backend engineering, with a focus on scalable systems, SaaS platforms, and cloud-native architecture. He started his career in PHP, then transitioned to Python, with occasional Node.js work along the way.

He actively uses AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex) for rapid prototyping and development acceleration.

Prefers working in startups and small teams where ownership is real and there is no corporate overhead.

## Core Skills

- Python, Django, Django REST Framework, FastAPI, Flask, Celery
- PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, RabbitMQ
- Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, CI/CD
- JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js
- Selenium Grid, E2E Testing, Test Automation
- AI-assisted development: Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex

## Experience Highlights

- Scalable backend systems and REST APIs
- SaaS platforms and multi-tenant architecture
- Distributed systems and async processing
- Test automation platforms
- Cloud-native development
- Code quality and technical mentoring

## Location
